title: Nutritious Dense Greek Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and nutritious Greek lamb stew featuring dashi and braising techniques, perfect for a dense and satisfying meal, with a bitter flavor profile balanced by rich lamb and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the dashi broth in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and celery and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, olives, parsley, lemon juice, and bay leaves, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Remove the bay leaves and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the stew cool, then refrigerate or freeze for later use.
Reheat the stew over low heat, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
